name: daily_etl_pipeline
description: 每日 ETL 数据管道 — DataX同步 → Flink提交 → Spark ETL

taskParams.rawScript:
#!/bin/bash
echo 'Starting DataX daily sync...'
# DataX 同步 MySQL → HDFS
python /opt/datax/bin/datax.py /opt/datax/job/mysql_to_hdfs_loan_application.json -p "-Ddt=${dt}"
python /opt/datax/bin/datax.py /opt/datax/job/mysql_to_hdfs_customer_info.json -p "-Ddt=${dt}"
python /opt/datax/bin/datax.py /opt/datax/job/mysql_to_hdfs_repayment_record.json -p "-Ddt=${dt}"
echo 'DataX sync completed'

#!/bin/bash
echo 'Submitting Flink streaming jobs...'
flink run -d /opt/flink/jobs/flink-jobs-1.0.0.jar
echo 'Flink jobs submitted'

#!/bin/bash
echo 'Running data quality checks...'
# 检查分区数据量
HIVE_COUNT=$(beeline -u jdbc:hive2://hive-server:10000 -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ods.ods_loan_application WHERE dt='${dt}'" 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
echo "ODS loan_application count: ${HIVE_COUNT}"
if [ "$HIVE_COUNT" -lt 1 ]; then
  echo 'ERROR: No data in ODS partition!'
  exit 1
fi
echo 'Quality check passed'
